readme: A curated list of game development resources to make **magic** happen. ### Submission Rules To get your pull request accepted, your link must follow these rules: - **Game dev only**: must be explicitly about game development, not a general tool. - **HTTPS only**: only secure (`https://`) links are accepted. - **100+ GitHub stars**: repo links need at least 100 stars. - **Alphabetical order**: place it in the correct position within its section. - **License tag required**: start with `:free:`, `:tada:`, `:moneybag:`, or `:money_with_wings:` (not required for Blogs and Portals, Videos/Podcasts, Game Jams, and Communities). ### License Legends - :free: - Free - :tada: - Open Source - :moneybag: - Paid - :money_with_wings: - Partially Free ## Table of Contents - [Graphics](#graphics) - [Assets/Placeholders](#assetsplaceholders) - [Spritesheet Tools](#spritesheet-tools) - [Bitmap Compression](#bitmap-compression) - [Texture Tools](#texture-tools) - [Character Generators](#character-generators) - [Tile/Level Editors](#tilelevel-editors) - [Animation](#animation) - [Vector/Image Editor](#vectorimage-editor) - [Videos/Podcasts](#videospodcasts) - [Game Jams](#game-jams) - [Project Management](#project-management) - [Complete Game Sources](#complete-game-sources) - [Communities](#communities) - [Ads](#ads) - [Learn](#learn) - [General Game Development](#general-game-development) - [Computer Graphics](#computer-graphics) ## Graphics _Great graphics placeholders and tools to turn that squared game into a picasso painting_ #### Assets/Placeholders - :free: [2D Cartoon Mobile Game UI Pack](https://graphicburger.com/mobile-game-gui/) - cartoon user interface asset pack. It comes as a layered psd file. - :free: [3DTexel](https://3dtexel.com/free-library/) - 1,600+ handmade CC0 assets: seamless PBR materials (incl. stylized), HDRIs, decals, 3D models and IES lights. A free account may be required for some downloads. - :free: [420 Pixel Art Icons for RPGs](https://7soul1.deviantart.com/art/420-Pixel-Art-Icons-for-RPG-129892453) - Set of 420 RPG icons, free for commercial use. - :free: [Blender 3D models](https://www.blender-models.com/) - 3D models, particle systems/effects - :free: [CC0 Materials](https://cc0materials.com) - Free CC0 PBR textures for game environments, up to 4K with OpenGL and DirectX normal maps for Unity, Unreal and Godot. - :money_with_wings: [CGTextures](https://www.textures.com) - A large collection of textures. - :free: [Crisp Icons Free](https://anipixels.itch.io/crisp-icons-free) - 42 rounded game UI icons in white and dark, as 64 px PNG and SVG; royalty-free for commercial use, no credit required. Drawn procedurally by code written with an AI assistant, no image generators. - :money_with_wings: [GameDev Market](https://www.gamedevmarket.net/) - a community-driven marketplace that connects indie game developers with talented asset creators. - :free: [Games-Icons Set](https://game-icons.net/) - free icons for your games. - :money_with_wings: [Gridwright](https://gridwright.store/) - Pixel-art game asset packs on one grid (tilesets, characters, UI, icons, effects, isometric, music and SFX) for any engine, many with Godot scenes and Tiled tilesets. Each pack has a free sample. - :free: [Iconito Game Food Icons](https://iconi.to/game-food-icons) - Food icons for cooking, farming and cozy games, free under the MIT license as SVG, in Figma and on Iconify. - :free: [Iconmonstr](https://iconmonstr.com/) - Another free icons resource for your games. - :free: [JadeRealms](https://3dmodelhub.io/models/) - Free GLB/Blender game models with browser previews; AI-assisted JadeRealms assets use custom commercial-use terms restricting raw redistribution. Other collections keep their source licenses. - :money_with_wings: [Kenney Assets](https://kenney.nl/assets) - Royalty free assets - :free: [Liberated Pixel Cup assets](https://lpc.opengameart.org) - Free graphic assets of the Liberated Pixel Cup (LPC) held by the OpenGameArt forums - :free: [Matcaps](https://github.com/nidorx/matcaps#matcaps) - A Huge library of matcap textures in PNG and ZMT, organized by color. - :free: [Minecraft Pixel Art](https://minecraft-pixel-art.com/editor/blueprint) - Browser image-to-Minecraft block blueprints with material lists, PNG plans and Java structure NBT export; no account required. - :free: [OpenGameArt](https://opengameart.org/) - a media repository intended for use with free software game projects. - :moneybag: [Oryx Design Lab](https://oryxdesignlab.com/) - Cheap high quality royalty free sprites - :free: [pixelfx.io](https://pixelfx.io/) - Free animated pixel art effects for games, with browser previews, recoloring, and transparent PNG sprite sheet and animation JSON downloads; MIT-licensed library assets. - :free: [Pixelicious](https://www.pixelicious.xyz/) - Image-to-Pixel Art converter. - :money_with_wings: [PlainTextures](https://www.plaintextures.com/) - Free high resolution textures, brushes and photos - :free: [Poly Pizza](https://poly.pizza) - 6000+ free low poly models - :free: [Quaternius](https://quaternius.com/) - Thousands of free CC0 low-poly 3D models and animated characters. - :free: [Reiner's Tilesets](https://www.reinerstilesets.de/) - A blog with free 2D and 3D graphics. - :free: [SceneCrate Free 3D Game Assets](https://scenecrate.com/free-3d-game-assets) - Nine walkable CC0 1.0 3D browser-game scenes (buildings, heightfield terrain, and static props) in two measured GLB tiers, with JSON colliders and offline Three.js examples; no account required. - :free: [Sketchfab](https://sketchfab.com/) - Publish & embed interactive 3D models. - :free: [SpriteLib](https://www.widgetworx.com/spritelib/) - a collection of static and animated graphic objects (also commonly known as sprites). - :free: [StickyPNG](https://www.stickpng.com/) - Free transparent PNG images. - :free: [TextureHaven](https://texturehaven.com/) - Free textures with additional maps like displacement and bump maps. Also HDRIs. - :free: [TextureKing](https://www.textureking.com/) - Free material stock textures - :money_with_wings: [Vecteezy](https://www.vecteezy.com/) - Free Vector Art. - :free: [Verdant 00 Free Tileset Sampler](https://csaf.itch.io/verdant-00-sample) - 878 top down 16x16 pixel art tiles, including 16 complete 47 mask autotile sets, with importers for RPG Maker MZ, Tiled and Godot; royalty free for commercial use, no credit required. Drawn by a procedural pixel engine written with an AI assistant, no image generators. #### Spritesheet Tools - :free: [AnimGen Free Sprite Sheet Tools](https://animgen.com/tools) - Browser tools that convert GIFs to sprite sheets and back, slice grid sheets or auto-extract sprites from sheets with no grid, export PNG sequences, and remove solid or green-screen GIF backgrounds. Files stay on your device; sheets come with Aseprite-format JSON. - :moneybag: [Border Kit for Tiled](https://frenkitchio.itch.io/border-kit-for-tiled) - Python CLI to extrude PNG tilesets and update external TSX files while preserving tile IDs, animations and collision objects. - :tada: [Cheetah-Texture-Packer](https://github.com/scriptum/Cheetah-Texture-Packer) - High efficient and fast 2D bin packing tool - :free: [GIF to Sprite Sheet](https://giftospritesheet.com/) - Browser tool that turns a GIF, animated WebP or video into a PNG sprite sheet, with JSON atlas, Godot .tres and Sparrow XML export. Also cuts sheets into frames and plays a sheet back as a GIF. Files stay on your device. - :moneybag: [Gridwright](https://gridwright.dev/) - Pixel-art asset packs drawn on one grid, plus 35 browser tools for tilesets, autotiles, maps, sprite sheets, palettes, effects and sound, with Godot-ready exports. - :tada: [Libgdx Texture Packer](https://github.com/libgdx/libgdx/wiki/Texture-packer) - Texture Packer built into Libgdx - :tada: [Ludo Toolbox](https://ludo.ai/developers/toolbox) - Free, open-source (MIT) command-line tools that run offline: slice and join spritesheets, find a sprite's feet pivot and box/capsule colliders, check loops, recolor to Lospec palettes, cut tilesets, and export to Godot, Unity, Phaser and TexturePacker. Plain JSON output for scripts and coding agents. - :free: [MakerGIF Sprite Sheet Converter](https://makergif.com/gif-to-sprite-sheet) - Free browser-based GIF and short-video to PNG sprite sheet converter with live WASD animation playtesting, Phaser 3 JSON, and Sparrow v2 XML export; files stay on your device with no account required. - :free: [PicMason Sprite Sheet Splitter](https://picmason.com/en/sprite-sheet-splitter/) - Browser-based fixed-grid splitter with custom frame sizes, offsets and spacing. Exports PNG frames preserving source transparency and a ZIP with source coordinates; can skip fully transparent frames. - :money_with_wings: [Puff](https://cs5475.itch.io/puff) - Preview pixel-art explosions and spell hits in the browser. The paid offline tool exports PNG sprite sheets, Godot 4 SpriteFrames and RPG Maker MV/MZ animations. - :free: [ShoeBox](http://renderhjs.net/shoebox/) - Adobe Air based app with game and ui related tools. - :tada: [SnowB Bitmap Font](https://snowb.org/) - Bitmap font generator - :free: [Sprite Sheet Builder](https://spritesheetbuilder.com/) - Free browser-based sprite sheet maker: pack frames, split atlases, convert GIFs, export PNG + JSON/XML for Unity, Godot, Phaser and FNF. - :free: [Sprite Sheet Slicer](https://capsulekit.pages.dev/sprite-sheet-slicer/) - Slice a sprite sheet by grid or cell size, preview the animation, and export PNG frames plus a Godot- and Unity-friendly JSON atlas. - :free: [SpriteCanvas Sprite Sheet Tools](https://spritecanvas.com/tools/) - Free browser tools that slice a sprite sheet into frames, pack images into a sheet, convert GIFs to sheets and back, and turn MP4/WebM clips into sheets with a JSON atlas. Files stay on your device; no account needed. - :free: [SpritePacker](https://spritepacker.app/) - Free browser sprite sheet packer with Compact (MaxRects), Grid, Horizontal and Vertical layouts, padding, extrude and trim. Exports PNG sheets with JSON Hash (Phaser, PixiJS), TexturePacker Generic XML or CSS/SCSS, or as an animated GIF. Frames are packed on your device; no account needed. - :free: [SpriteSheet.dev](https://spritesheet.dev/gif-to-spritesheet) - Browser tools that pack frames or a GIF into a sprite sheet (named animations per row, per-frame timing kept, pivot written to the data) with TexturePacker JSON, Aseprite JSON or Sparrow XML using FNF frame names, cut sheets back into frames by grid, data file or automatically, and turn sheets into GIFs. Exports tested loading in Phaser 3.90/4.2 and PixiJS 8.22. Files stay on your device. - :money_with_wings: [TexturePacker](https://www.codeandweb.com/texturepacker) - Great spritesheet creation editor. - :free: [Voidless Sprite Sheet Tools](https://voidless.dev/tools/sprite-sheet-slicer) - Free browser sprite sheet cutter/slicer and packer: cut a sheet into frames, or pack sprites into one atlas with PNG and Phaser/PixiJS JSON output. No account needed; files stay in the browser. #### Bitmap Compression - :money_with_wings: [BatchSet](https://batchset.com/tools/image-compressor) - Compress and convert whole folders of PNG, JPG and WebP sprites in the browser, nothing uploaded. - :tada: [ImageAlpha](https://pngmini.com/) — Mac OS X GUI for pngquant and other tools - :free: [Photo Resizer In KB](https://photoresizerinkb.com/) - Resize photos easily and free to use - :free: [PNGGauntlet](https://pnggauntlet.com/) - Smash PNGs for faster sites - :free: [PNGoo](https://pngquant.org/PNGoo.0.1.1.zip) - Windows GUI for batch conversion. - :tada: [Pngyu](https://nukesaq88.github.io/Pngyu/) - simple PNG image file compression tool. - :money_with_wings: [TinyPNG](https://tinypng.com/) - Advanced lossy compression for PNG images that preserves full alpha transparency. #### Texture Tools - :money_with_wings: [DDS Tools](https://ddstools.com/) - Browser-based DDS texture toolkit with a free viewer for mipmaps, channels, cubemap faces and texture metadata. Converts images to DDS and DDS to PNG or JPG locally, with compression, mipmap and normal-map settings. - :moneybag: [FilterForge](https://www.filterforge.com/) - A plugin for Adobe Photoshop that allows you to build your own filters. - :money_with_wings: [GameShipKit Sprite Normal Map](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/sprite-normal-map/) - Generate normal maps from 2D sprites for lit 2D scenes. - :free: [Live Normal](https://tenebrislab.github.io/livenormal/) - An Android and iOS app for generating seamless materials on the go. You take a photo, and Live Normal creates a tile-able texture and generates texture maps ready for a PBR engine of your choice. - :free: [Nebula Forge](https://nebulakit.itch.io/nebula-forge) - Browser-based procedural nebula background generator with adjustable controls and PNG export. Runs locally without signup. - :free: [Normal Map Bench](https://normalmapbench.com/) - Generate tangent-space normal maps for game textures from height images in the browser, with a live lighting preview and OpenGL or DirectX PNG export. - :free: [PD Sigil Forge](https://pixeldreamerstudio.itch.io/pd-sigil-forge) - Free browser generator of game-ready magic circles, xianxia formations, sci-fi holo rings, kamon crests and paper talismans for spell VFX; transparent PNG + spin sheets. - :moneybag: [PixPlant](https://www.pixplant.com/) - PixPlant is a smart 3D texturing tool that creates high quality normal, displacement, specular maps and seamless textures from photos. - :tada: [Sprite Fusion Sprite Normals](https://github.com/Hugo-Dz/spritefusion-sprite-normals) - Generate normal maps from pixel art sprites and animations. #### Character Generators - :free: [AvatarSay Fantasy NPC Generator](https://avatarsay.com/fantasy-npc-generator?ref=awesome-magictools&utm_medium=awesome-list&utm_campaign=mcp) - Browser-based fantasy and RPG NPC character generator with randomized ancestry, roles, traits, and portrait prompts for game development and tabletop campaigns (no signup required). - :free: [Charas](http://charas-project.net/index.php) - Charas is a charset generator for RPG Maker. - :money_with_wings: [GameShipKit 2D Character Rigging](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/character-rigging/) - Rig a 2D character in the browser and export idle, walk and attack animations as sprite sheets. #### Tile/Level Editors - :moneybag: [AutoTileGen](https://pixelatto.com) - AutoTileGen is an automatic tileset generator for 2D game terrains. - :money_with_wings: [GameShipKit Autotile Generator](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/autotile-generator/) - Make blob and RPG Maker style autotiles from two textures, with Godot 4 and Tiled tilesets. - :money_with_wings: [GameShipKit Map Generator](https://gameshipkit.com/tools/map-generator/) - Seeded dungeon, cave and island maps, exported as PNG, Tiled JSON and CSV. - :tada: [LDtk](https://deepnight.net/tools/ldtk-2d-level-editor/) - LDtk is an open-source 2D level editor for indie devs, with a strong focus on user-friendliness. - :money_with_wings: [MapperMate](https://mappermate.com/) - A cloud based tile map editor used to create 2D levels directly in the browser. - :tada: [Material Maker](https://github.com/RodZill4/material-maker) - procedural texture creator made in Godot - :tada: [OGMO Editor](https://ogmo-editor-3.github.io/)- generic level editor. - :tada: [Overlap2D](https://github.com/UnderwaterApps/overlap2d/) - a 2D level and UI editor with an engine agnostic philosophy. - :free: [SimplePixelArt Tileset Editor](https://simplepixelart.com/tilesets/editor) - Draw auto-tile tilesets in the browser and export them as Godot TileSet (.tres) and Tiled (.tsx) files. - :free: [Sprite Fusion](https://spritefusion.com/) - A free level design tool to craft beautiful 2D tilemaps right in your browser using any tileset. - :tada: [Tiled](https://www.mapeditor.org/) - free, easy to use and flexible tile map editor. #### Animation - :moneybag: [Animate4Me](https://animate4me.com/) - Turns a text prompt or an image into a Spine 4.2 animation with bones and weighted meshes for 2D game symbols, objects and characters; previews in the browser and exports skeleton.json, atlas and PNG pages. - :moneybag: [AnimKit](https://www.nasrtech.dev/animkit) - Maya animation toolkit with live tweening, smart keys, motion trails, a pose library and Mixamo retargeting. An affordable animBot alternative. - :money_with_wings: [Cascadeur](https://cascadeur.com/) - Powerful physics-based 3D character animation - :moneybag: [Fusion Character Animator](http://loopengo.free.fr/) - small tool for Clickteam Fusion 2.5 to facilitate the animation of 2D character sprites for developers. - :free: [GameAsset.net](https://gameasset.net/) - 10,000+ free CC0 character animations, previewable in 3D with GLB download. - :free: [GraphicsDale](https://graphicsgale.com/us/) - Powerful tool for spriting and pixel art. - :tada: [LWF](https://gree.github.
